text: At the invitation of the Chair, Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee, Sze Ching (Michelle) Pang, Toronto Women In Action - Housing Advocacy Coordinator, Nellie’s, will give a presentation on key findings from the Breaking Barriers position paper, focusing on the lived experiences of women with disabilities navigating Toronto’s affordable housing system. It highlights systemic accessibility barriers and proposes actionable recommendations to improve equity, accountability, and access at the municipal level.
The Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee received the item for information.
